name: Utilorax Developer API
description:
A free JSON API for everyday utilities: hashing and encoding, unit conversion, text transforms, calculators, generators, date and number helpers, web lookups, and real file conversion for PDFs, images and documents.

No account is needed to try it — unauthenticated requests get 10 a day. A free key raises that to 500 a month. Every response is JSON of the shape `{"ok": true, "result": …}`, and errors are `{"ok": false, "error": "…"}` with a 4xx or 5xx status.

CORS is open, so the API can be called straight from a browser.
